title: dopt-augmentation: sequential D-optimal augmentation of an existing experimental record
description:
Data and code for D-Optimal Augmentation of OFAT Datasets for Machine Learning-Based Thickness Prediction in HfO2 PEALD.

The routine proposes the next experiments for a record whose conditions are known. It reads no measured response, so it runs on any process, and the whole set of additions can be fixed before the first of them is performed. After each addition it reports the rank of the quadratic model matrix, log10 det(X'X), the condition number and the mean absolute feature correlation.

Included are the 42 one-factor-at-a-time and 15 D-optimal process conditions of the study with their thickness measurements, the order in which the 15 were selected, and a second worked example on a different material, precursor, substrate and reactor.

The code is released under the MIT licence and the data files under CC BY 4.0.

Version 1.1 adds the cross-validation analysis of the revised manuscript: leave-one-condition-out cross-validation, a same-test-set comparison of models trained with and without the D-optimal conditions, condition-level bootstrap confidence intervals, and the thickness at all five wafer positions.
